instruction: You need a USB-C charging cable. This page is wall-to-wall deals — Spotlight Deal, Trending Deals, category banners. Ignore those. Use the search bar to look for usb-c cable.
notes: eBay homepage loads cleanly headlessly (no CAPTCHA, no Access-Denied wall). The page has 8+ H2 promo banners (Ralph Lauren -70%, Carhartt -45%, Memorial Day -20%, etc.) — much richer promo distraction signal than Walmart's homepage. The agent's correct first action is to use #gh-search-btn instead of any of the banners. Switched here from real_walmart.json on May 22 after observing Walmart's PerimeterX bot detection fires even with warmed cookies — Playwright's headers + JS-execution patterns trigger CAPTCHA regardless of session state. eBay's bot detection is less aggressive.
